terrain_quality_policy: Finite values in a published interpolated elevation grid are model terrain, with count-mask quality retained. Coarser published terrain may resolve unavailable near samples and is labeled as a resolution downgrade. NaN, nodata and unresolved coverage remain unknown. Strict measured-only diagnostics remain available separately.
redistribution: Numerical terrain binaries are acquired locally, hash verified and excluded from the repository. One unmodified pinned NAIF Earth-orientation kernel is retained under data/pinned under NAIF redistribution rules because its rolling source URL expired. Retain citations and source-specific terms.
limitations: Available model coverage is not a landing-safety certification.
Published interpolation and spatial/time sampling introduce declared approximations; this model provides no calibrated uncertainty distribution.
Radio payload rates and service calendars are assumed, with ideal pointing; no RF link closure or reserved station access is claimed.
The relay preset is synthetic_two_body_lunar_preset, not an operational or frozen lunar orbit.

dataset_revision.purpose: Complete source-tile acquisition for hosted fresh calculation; original v1 source hashes and archived results remain distinct.
